# Stormscope

> Independent hurricane tracker displaying official National Hurricane Center forecasts and National Weather Service alerts. It does not issue forecasts or safety instructions.

For current conditions, use the official sources linked on each page. Saved advisories may be historical.

## Pages

- [Storm tracker](https://isaiastracker.site/): latest available storm map and advisory links.
- [Data and methodology](https://isaiastracker.site/about): sources, update timing and limitations.
- [Privacy](https://isaiastracker.site/privacy): visitor data and external services.
- [Terms](https://isaiastracker.site/terms): use of this information tool.

## Official sources

- [National Hurricane Center](https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/)
- [National Weather Service](https://www.weather.gov/)
